content: Coley Fluid is a contemporary reformulation of a historical cancer treatment known as the Coley Vaccine, which was originally developed by Dr. William B. Coley. This treatment demonstrated significant efficacy in managing various types of cancer, including advanced breast cancer. A study conducted in 1982 concluded that the five-year survival rates of patients treated with the historical Coley Vaccine were comparable to the five-year survival rates of patients treated with modern cancer therapies. Furthermore, research published in 1999 revealed that the ten-year survival rates were higher in patients who had received the historical Coley Vaccine compared to those of modern patients with sarcoma, kidney cancer, and ovarian cancer. Coley Fluid is currently produced by MBVax Bioscience Inc., a company based in Ancaster, Canada.
